name: TC Drive
name_zh: 深圳市同川科技有限公司
summary: TC Drive develops and manufactures harmonic reducers, integrated rotary actuators and robot joint modules. Its portfolio includes industrial rotary transmission, collaborative robot joints and lightweight harmonic joints for humanoid robots.
